metadata.framework: connexion/Flask (OpenAPI server, plus a parallel KG2 variant) + Tornado (autocomplete service); sqlite3 raw-SQL data layer, SQLAlchemy ORM for tracker/cache
notes: Pass 5 (CWE-89 SQL Injection) labeling only; 668 CSV candidate rows (255 source-side incl. intermediate rows + 413 sink-side) processed in 5 inline batches by the session model, plus 7 code-evidence sanitizer entries added beyond the CSV rows.

Model: glm-5.3 (the Claude Code session model performing inline labeling; no external LLM API call was made; determinism guardrails: fixed confidence values, rule-consistent rationales, deterministic generation script labels/generate_labels_pass5.py).

The pass_id 1 block is a schema-compatibility placeholder with zero entries: assets/labels_schema.json imposes a passes.contains constraint requiring a pass_id=1 item in every labels.json. Pass 1 (Path Traversal) was NOT labeled in this round; pass 5 is the only labeled pass.

No exact (file, line, node) duplicates were found in either CSV; the UI/OpenAPI python-flask-server/KG2 controller rows are a parallel deployment copy of the non-KG2 controllers (different files) and were labeled with identical decisions rather than merged.

Confirmed attacker-to-SQL-text flows: (1) GET /nodeslike -> get_argument('word') -> rtxcomplete.get_nodes_like -> unescaped f-string SQL at rtxcomplete.py:49/76/88/112 (word channel; limit is int()-cast); (2) POST /query|/asyncquery body -> ARAX pipeline -> predictor.py:65/328-372 unescaped curie/disease/drug interpolation and fisher_exact_test.py:579 unescaped category interpolation (qnode categories are user-supplied TRAPI fields).

Neutralized-but-raw channels kept as sink/fp with sanitizer evidence: quote-doubling (node_synonymizer.py:1931 family, ARAX_decorator.py:67/149, fisher_exact_test.py:456), quote-exclusion (compute_ngd.py:346), bound `?` parameters (node_synonymizer access methods, rtxcomplete inserts, all ETL scripts), named binds (ARAX_query_tracker.py:283-291), dataset_id 1/2/3 whitelist + isinstance type guards (COHDIndex).

COHD pair-branch sinks (COHDIndex.py:983-1053) remain classification=candidate: the only live caller (overlay_clinical_info.py:176-178) passes 'omop1_omop2' strings produced by the trusted cohd.io mapping API - second-order, currently numeric; flagged for human review.

Offline CLI/ETL scripts (kg2c, GraphSage py_scripts, KGNodeIndex, ngd build, autocomplete create_load_db, reasoningtool, NLPCode) and their argparse/sys.argv sources were reviewed and labeled none/fp per detection.json's cli_env exclusion - operator-controlled, retained as evidence, not counted as live vulnerabilities.

Django/psycopg/SQLAlchemy-raw-SQL are not used in the SQL-relevant paths: SQLAlchemy appears only as ORM (tracker/response cache/feedback) plus the parameterized text() fragments; neo4j Cypher usage is out of CWE-89 scope.
